description: Normalize parsed Zeek conn/dns events to ECS + UEBA 1.0.0

script.source: if(ctx._path!='conn' && ctx._path!='dns'){throw new IllegalArgumentException('unsupported Zeek path '+ctx._path);} if(ctx.id==null || ctx.id.orig_h==null || ctx.id.resp_h==null){throw new IllegalArgumentException('missing Zeek endpoints');} ctx.source=['ip':ctx.id.orig_h]; ctx.destination=['ip':ctx.id.resp_h]; if(ctx.id.orig_p!=null)ctx.source.port=ctx.id.orig_p; if(ctx.id.resp_p!=null)ctx.destination.port=ctx.id.resp_p; ctx.network=new HashMap(); if(ctx.proto!=null)ctx.network.transport=ctx.proto.toLowerCase(); if(ctx.service!=null)ctx.network.protocol=ctx.service.toLowerCase(); if(ctx.local_orig==true && ctx.local_resp==false)ctx.network.direction='outbound'; else if(ctx.local_orig==false && ctx.local_resp==true)ctx.network.direction='inbound'; else if(ctx.local_orig==true && ctx.local_resp==true)ctx.network.direction='internal'; else ctx.network.direction='unknown'; ctx.observer=['id':ctx.sensor_id,'name':ctx.sensor_id,'vendor':'Zeek','product':'Zeek','type':'sensor']; ctx.ueba.source=['type':'zeek_'+ctx._path,'namespace':ctx.tenant_id+'/'+ctx.sensor_id,'native_event_id':ctx.uid]; ctx.ueba.session=['id':ctx.uid,'type':'network_flow']; ctx.ueba.time=['source':'zeek_ts','quality':'exact']; ctx.ueba.provenance=['raw_event_id':ctx.tenant_id+'/'+ctx.sensor_id+'/'+ctx._path+'/'+ctx.uid+'/'+ctx.ts,'parser_id':'zeek_json','parser_version':'1.0.0','mapping_id':'zeek_'+ctx._path+'_json','mapping_version':'1.0.0']; ctx.event.id=ctx.ueba.provenance.raw_event_id; def warnings=new ArrayList(); if(ctx._path=='conn'){ctx.event.category=['network'];ctx.event.type=['connection'];ctx.event.action='network-connection';ctx.event.dataset='zeek.zeek.conn';ctx.ueba.event=['type':'network.connection'];if(ctx.duration!=null)ctx.event.duration=(long)(ctx.duration*1000000000L);if(ctx.orig_ip_bytes!=null)ctx.source.bytes=ctx.orig_ip_bytes;if(ctx.resp_ip_bytes!=null)ctx.destination.bytes=ctx.resp_ip_bytes;if(ctx.orig_pkts!=null)ctx.source.packets=ctx.orig_pkts;if(ctx.resp_pkts!=null)ctx.destination.packets=ctx.resp_pkts;if(ctx.source.bytes!=null&&ctx.destination.bytes!=null)ctx.network.bytes=ctx.source.bytes+ctx.destination.bytes;if(ctx.source.packets!=null&&ctx.destination.packets!=null)ctx.network.packets=ctx.source.packets+ctx.destination.packets;if(ctx.missed_bytes!=null&&ctx.missed_bytes>0)warnings.add('zeek_missed_bytes');}else{if(ctx.query==null)throw new IllegalArgumentException('missing DNS query');ctx.event.category=['network'];ctx.event.type=['protocol'];ctx.event.action='dns-response';ctx.event.dataset='zeek.zeek.dns';ctx.event.outcome=(ctx.rcode_name=='NOERROR'?'success':'failure');ctx.ueba.event=['type':'dns.response'];ctx.network.protocol='dns';ctx.dns=['id':ctx.trans_id?.toString(),'question':['name':ctx.query,'type':ctx.qtype_name],'response_code':ctx.rcode_name];if(ctx.answers!=null){def result=new ArrayList();for(int i=0;i<ctx.answers.size();i++){def answer=['data':ctx.answers[i]];if(ctx.TTLs!=null&&i<ctx.TTLs.size())answer.ttl=(long)ctx.TTLs[i];result.add(answer);}ctx.dns.answers=result;}if(ctx.rtt!=null)ctx.event.duration=(long)(ctx.rtt*1000000000L);} ctx.ueba.quality=['status':warnings.isEmpty()?'qualified':'partial','score':warnings.isEmpty()?1.0:0.8,'errors':new ArrayList(),'warnings':warnings];
